alex.green: Heads-up — Horizon marketplace listing goes live next Tue (2026-04-07). Need formal partner SEV path + joint war room ready. Can we lock channel & oncall liaisons?

maria.chen: +1. Suggest #horizon-marketplace-sev (shared with partner). Who's liaison on Redwood side?

jess.kim: I can steward the first 48h post-launch. Propose rotation: jess.kim -> liam.o -> samir.p (12/12/12h handoffs). Partner needs to confirm their on-call contact too.

liam.o: Can we standardize trigger criteria? e.g. 5xx rate >1% sustained for 5m, or customer error spike >30% in 15m, or failed orders >100/min.

samir.p: +1 for the triggers. Also propose automated war-room creation via ops-bot: `/warroom create horizon-marketplace --shared partnerships` so we don't waste time.

ops-bot: War room command available. Usage: `/warroom create <name> --participants <comma-list> --template <launch|sev|billing>`. Default template = launch.

maria.chen: Draft escalation steps below — comments?

``` 
Escalation checklist (Horizon Marketplace):
1) Trigger detected -> page partner_oncall and oncall rotation (pager + email)
2) Create joint war room using ops-bot: `/warroom create horizon-marketplace --participants alex.green,maria.chen,jess.kim,partner_oncall`
3) Run quick health checks: `/infra check marketplace` and paste results
4) Add partner as read-only observer and share logs (temp S3 role + 24h)
5) If unresolved in 60 mins -> escalate to eng-sre rotation + product lead
6) If >2 hours with customer-impacting errors -> exec notify and remediation timeline
``` 

jess.kim: For partner access we should use temporary IAM role with least-privilege and audit logs enabled. Maria, can you flag to security for KMS ACL check?

maria.chen: Yup — will request temporary role and set TTL=24h. Also add SIEM alerting for partner sessions.

partner_oncall: Partner contact confirmed: ops@horizon-sys.com (Pager: +1-555-0102). They'll add their on-call rotations tomorrow.

liam.o: Also propose a short war-room template doc (1pager) with owner, primary checks, rollback hints, and contact list. I'll draft and post in #docs-launch.

alex.green: Great. Action items:
- jess.kim: steward launch + rotation schedule

- ops-bot: ensure warroom template ready
Partner to confirm oncall by EOD.
